name: Telegram bot token
description: Bot tokens in api.telegram.org URLs; the bot prefix is kept.

name: AWS access key ID
description: Access key IDs that start with AKIA or ASIA.

name: GitHub token
description: Personal, OAuth, user, server and refresh tokens (ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_, ghr_).

name: Email address
description: Any email address, in messages, URLs and breadcrumbs alike.

name: JWT
description: JSON Web Tokens: three dot-separated base64url parts, the first two starting with eyJ.

name: Authorization: Bearer value
description: The token after "Authorization: Bearer", however short; the header name is kept.

name: Slack token
description: Bot, user and app tokens such as xoxb-, xoxp- and xoxa-.

name: Stripe secret or restricted key
description: Secret (sk_) and restricted (rk_) keys, live or test; publishable pk_ keys are left alone.

name: PEM private key block
description: A whole -----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY----- block, header to footer.

name: IPv4 address
description: Dotted IPv4 addresses anywhere in text, not only in the client IP fields.
